discussions with his counterpart within the Government of Canada 
with a view to resolving outstanding concerns respecting the 
future structural viability of the Saint John Harbour Bridge”
And the question being put on the amendment, a debate ensued.
And after some time, it was agreed by unanimous consent 
to suspend consideration of the amendment to Motion 60 to 
allow Members to make certain remarks on the occasion of 
Mr. Huntjens’ last day in the Legislative Assembly.
And after some further time, Mr. Fraser resumed the chair.
And the debate being ended and the question being put, the 
amendment was defeated on the following recorded division:
YEAS - 17
Mr. Fitch  Mr. Harrison  Mr. Betts
Ms. Dubé  Mr. MacDonald Mr. C. LeBlanc
Mr. Alward  Mr. Holder  Mr. Olscamp
Mr. Volpé  Mr. Jody Carr  Mr. C. Landry

Mr. Deputy Speaker advised the House that the word 
“unanimously” would be removed from the resolution clause in 
Motion 60.
His Honour, the Lieutenant-Governor, was announced, and having 
been bidden to enter, took his seat in the chair upon the Throne.
Mr. Deputy Speaker addressed His Honour as follows:
